leak: Put life shorter than designed exit stack

decision_record.transfer: The -3% day tail put's payer is gap/continuation risk over the following sessions; a put with <5 days to expiry mostly sells back theta — the buyer (us) pays premium for life the 5-session/50%-loss exit stack can never use.
decision_record.comparison: Control: enter any put with expiry > session (first ENH). Treatment: refuse expiry <5 calendar days after session.
decision_record.mechanism: First ENH only refused expiry <= session; a Monday-expiring put bought Friday still dies before the five-session hold or a premium-loss exit can be evaluated on schedule.
decision_record.calculation: Fixture: SPY261026P bought 2026-10-23 (3 days) -> 0 ON, 1 OFF; SPY261030P (7 days) still enters ON.
